```{=typst}
#let project-grid-card(img-path, title, description) = {
  box(
    width: 100%,
    stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#e5e7eb"),
    inset: 10pt,
  )[
    #image(img-path, width: 100%, height: 80pt, fit: "contain")
    #v(6pt)
    #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#111827"), size: 9.5pt)[#title]\
    #v(2pt)
    #text(fill: rgb("#6b7280"), size: 8.5pt)[#description]
  ]
}

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 8pt,
  project-grid-card(
    "images/projects/cc-medical.svg",
    "Medical Device Platform",
    "Cambridge Consultants — Developed embedded software for a connected medical device, integrating real-time sensor processing with cloud-based analytics.",
  ),
  project-grid-card(
    "images/projects/cc-industrial.svg",
    "Industrial IoT System",
    "Cambridge Consultants — Built firmware and data pipeline for an industrial monitoring platform, enabling predictive maintenance through edge computing.",
  ),
  project-grid-card(
    "images/projects/cc-consumer.svg",
    "Consumer Electronics Prototype",
    "Cambridge Consultants — Delivered proof-of-concept software for a next-generation consumer device, from low-level drivers to companion app integration.",
  ),
  project-grid-card(
    "images/projects/side-project.svg",
    "Paid Side Projects",
    "Contract work across web applications, data tooling, and automation — delivering production systems for small businesses and startups.",
  ),
)
```

```{=typst}
#let project-card(img-path, title, description) = {
  block(
    width: 100%,
    stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#e5e7eb"),
    inset: 12pt,
    below: 8pt,
  )[
    #grid(
      columns: (80pt, 1fr),
      gutter: 12pt,
      box(
        stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#e5e7eb"),
        image(img-path, width: 80pt),
      ),
      [
        #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#111827"), size: 10pt)[#title]\
        #v(2pt)
        #text(fill: rgb("#6b7280"), size: 9pt)[#description]
      ],
    )
  ]
}

#project-card(
  "images/projects/geosnap.svg",
  "GeoSnap — Co-Founder & CTO",

)
```
